$comment: Every divergence CI takes on purpose, in one list, with the issue that owns it and the date it expires.
quarantine           - a suite CI does not run.  tests/util/Quarantine.ts reads it.
platform-expectation - an assertion whose expected value differs per platform, because the
tests/unit/ci/QuarantineRegistry.test.ts enforces this file in both directions: an entry that
nothing uses fails, a use with no entry fails, and an entry past its `expires` fails.  That last
one is the point.  A quarantine that cannot expire is what this file replaces: the previous
arrangement wrote the exit criterion into a YAML comment and asked a human to count nights.
To renew, push { date, reason } onto `history` and move `expires`.  Three renewals is the cap;
after that the choice is to fix the subject or to delete the test, and neither is a config change.

entries.label: max-connections enforced by the runtime
entries.reason: Bun honours server.maxConnections on Windows and not on ubuntu-latest. Measured: 5/5 red in the nightly stress job on 2026-09-05 and 2026-09-06, and a standalone node:http probe closes the second connection under bun 1.4.0 and node v26.7.0 on Windows.
